Project Description

What's New

The BLM has no role in hiring construction contractors for this project. 

Please do not contact the BLM regarding construction work. 

You can contact the applicant, 174 PowerGlobal (https://174powerglobal.com/), or the construction contractor, Q-Cells, us.qcells.com, for information.  

==========================================================================================

6/17/2025: The Notice of Proposed Decision on the K Lazy B Allotment Grazing Permit Modification (June 11, 2025) is now posted on the Documents page. 

======================================================================================================= 


The BLM Colorado River District Manager and the Secretary of the Interior's designee signed the Record of Decision on January 3, 2025, approving the Wash Avoidance Alternative. The ROD is posted on the Documents page.   


Past Notices: 

The Jove Solar Energy Project Final EIS and the Plan of Development was published on the Documents page on November 15, 2024.  The BLM's Preferred Alternative remains the Wash Avoidance Alternative. 


Draft EIS published April 19, 2024.  The Draft EIS was available for public review and a 45-day comment period, from April 19 through June 3.  The document is available on the Documents page.  


The recording of the May 14 Draft EIS meeting is posted on the BLM Arizona YouTube channel. The slides are posted on the Documents page. 


 Notice of Intent starting EIS process published December 7, 2022.

The BLM Yuma Field Office published a Notice of Intent and Segregation for the proposed Jove Solar Project in the Federal Register on December 7, 2022.  The Notice initiates formal scoping and a two-year mineral segregation.
